violations.text: The floor by the back three bay is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/24/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC is trained as a Food Safety Manager. PIC must renew with RIDOH CFP as a Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were placed at sink during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer, potato slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Establishment moved deli slicer and can opener to three bay during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Food items prepared in advance were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Establishment is to date all food items prepared in advance or removed from original manufactured package. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Chemicals was stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Chemicals were moved during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Potatoes was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Establishment moved Potatoes to baking sheets one layer high. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Establishment is to obtain a thermometer. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Potatoes were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Potatoes were moved to a shelf in the kitchen. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The dishwasher located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Dishwasher was lacking chemical chlorine sanitizer. Establishment is to obtain chemical sanitizer for low temp mechanical dishwasher. Establishment is to continue to sanitize in three bay sink until chemical sanitizer is purchased and dishwasher is reaching appropriate sanitizing concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The facility is lacking drain stoppers for the three bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain stoppers. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the grill line by the window, the shelving by the window, and the fryolator in the back kitchen have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2026
The floor by the back three bay is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/24/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
The floor by the three bay is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer, potato slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Sliced cheese, turkey, and ham was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
The dishwasher located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. All sanitizing being done in three bay. Establishment is to have dishwasher repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 04/22/2025

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the 1 door refrigerator, fryolator, and counters have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Establishment is to clean and maintain all non food contact surfaces. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
The floor by the three bay is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2025
The floors and walls have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
